metadata.description: Sharekit operator harness profile: curated skills, hooks, agents, and standards packaged as a Claude Code marketplace, one plugin per concern.

plugins.name: core-skills
plugins.description: Curated portable skills (curated-skills.txt): workflows, composites, and operator utilities.

plugins.name: security-hooks
plugins.description: Curated portable hooks (curated-hooks.txt): policy gates, drift checks, and session guards that ship to installers.

plugins.name: gate-hooks
plugins.description: Repo governance hooks: constitution gates, catalog guards, and CI drift checks for the profile itself.

plugins.name: role-agents
plugins.description: Curated portable agents (curated-agents.txt): critic, reviewer, debugger, and specialist roles.

plugins.name: review-pack
plugins.description: CI-native multi-agent review pack: risk-tiered reviewer fan-out plus a coordinator judge pass emitting one severity-rated review (critical-only blocking).

plugins.name: standards
plugins.description: Operator standards and decision records (curated-standards.txt): routing, testing, security, workflow.

plugins.name: typed-schemas
plugins.description: Shared schema contracts (typed-result-schema.md) kept at the repo root for cross-harness reuse.
